route_version_binding: host must bind the new-v8 accepted tool/code/config hash before case preparation; no silent route change
capture: host records request/response provenance, capture bytes/hash and model-delivered ranges mechanically; positive source acquisition requires actual capture plus delivered-range evidence
availability: uncaptured or unavailable sources remain unresolved; candidate-authored access assertions are not host acquisition proof
within_case_reuse: research, fresh critic and fresh correction may read this case's raw admitted public-source captures; each may independently fetch further allowed public sources
cross_case_reuse: prohibited: no captures, discoveries, proposals, critiques, source selections, evaluator lists, rulings or feedback from another case/arm
